title: India API endpoints
note: On the date in last_tested (IST), one GET to the URL, sent with no key, returned HTTP 2xx and a non-empty data body. HTML pages and empty results did not pass. The format column records what came back. This is a test result for that date, not a promise that the URL answers today. Licences, terms, rate limits, accuracy and freshness were not reviewed. Endpoints are URLs, not separate APIs; many share one service.
licence: CC BY 4.0: credit AgentPopulation and link https://agentpopulation.com
focus: host ends with ".in" OR host in (aviationweather.gov, api.open-meteo.com, air-quality-api.open-meteo.com, api.met.no, api.sunrise-sunset.org, ckan.himdataportal.com, ckan.meghalayadataportal.com) OR title matches /india|andhra|yamuna/i

buckets.name: Agent tools
buckets.title: Airport weather lookups for Indian airports
buckets.filter: tags has agent-ready AND url matches /aviationweather\.gov/api/data/(metar|taf)/i
buckets.criteria: Services in this pack with the most endpoints that match this bucket and are tagged agent-ready (no key sent in the test call, JSON body, passed a data call). Ties go to the service with more country codes, then by name. Only services with at least one bucket row that matches the focus rule are listed, and the sample comes from those rows; the counts cover the whole bucket. The sample URL is the first row by URL sort after preferring, in this order: rows that match the bucket's sample preference when it has one, rows that return values rather than describe a dataset or a service (not ERDDAP /info/ pages, OGC GetCapabilities requests, bare OWS addresses, PxWeb tables, UN SDG series lists, Statistics Canada download pointers, WorldPop listings, GTFS validation reports, untitled rows or service root addresses), and agent-ready rows. Services named "ArcGIS organization" hold map layers from many owners and are added only when fewer than 5 other services match.
